stem: 一家房地产投资公司的所有者在三个月内分多次存入用现金购买的多张银行本票,这些本票来自两套公寓的销售所得.该账户还收到了来自其他金融机构的几笔每笔1万美元的电子转账.哪些活动被视为洗钱的可疑行为？

options.A: 接收来自其他金融机构的多笔电子转账，每笔金额为1万美元
options.B: 在一段时间内用现金购买多张银行本票
options.C: 与房地产投资公司开展业务

stem_en: The owner of a real estate investment company deposits multiple cashier's checks that were bought using cash over a three-month period from the sale of two apartments. This account also receives several electronic transfers from other financial institutions for US$10,000 each. What activity is considered suspicious of money laundering?

options_en.A: Receiving electronic transfers for US$10,000 amounts from other financial institutions
options_en.B: Using cash to buy multiple cashier's checks over a period of time
options_en.C: Performing operations with real estate investment companies
